// Ensure phone login modal is closed }; // Toggle email login modal visibility const toggleEmailLoginModal = () => { setIsEmailLoginModalOpen((prev) => !prev); setIsLoginModalOpen(false); // Close main login modal when email login modal is open }; // Toggle phone login modal visibility const togglePhoneLoginModal = () => { setIsPhoneLoginModalOpen((prev) => !prev); setIsLoginModalOpen(false); // Close main login modal when phone login modal is open }; // Toggle signup modal visibility const toggleSignupModal = () => { setIsSignupModalOpen((prev) => !prev); setIsLoginModalOpen(false); // Close main login modal when signup modal is open }; // Toggle user dropdown visibility const toggleUserDropdown = () => { setIsUserDropdownOpen((prev) => !prev); }; // Update the selected location const handleLocationChange = (location) => { setSelectedLocation(location); setIsDropdownOpen(false); // Close the dropdown after selection }; // Handle search form submission const handleSearch = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (searchQuery.trim()) { navigate(`/search?query=${searchQuery}&location=${selectedLocation}`); } }; // Handle login form submission const handleLogin = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const email = e.target.email.value; const password = e.target.password.value; // Check if user exists in the user list const user = users.find((user) => user.email === email && user.password === password); if (user) { setLoggedInUser(user); // Set the logged-in user setIsLoginModalOpen(false); // Close the login modal } else { alert('Invalid email or password'); } }; return (
